hypothesis: A strict same-run immutable prefix delta can make continuous live-canary review reproducible by separating resolved execution economics, provisional open-lifecycle paths, and technical coverage changes without creating strategy or execution authority.
decision: Adopt the report-only prefix-delta workflow and retain the running v25 strategy unchanged. The measured 43.22-minute prefix added 327 ledger rows but no close, fill, fee, funding, or resolved PnL change. Four open lifecycles remained continuously identified and protected; their mark and path changes remain provisional. The existing HIP-3 provider metric defect accumulated 20 additional null values while its technical-gap identity stayed unchanged. This warrants continued observation and the already-staged future clock-repair acceptance test, not an economic strategy revision, live exit-policy change, restart, drain, route change, order mutation, resize, or promotion.
falsifier: The monitoring method is falsified by accepting different run or profile identities, backward row or time movement, an overwritten output, a removed open lifecycle without explicitly distinguishing a matching close from an unresolved disappearance, arithmetic disagreement with source audits, changed or missing source evidence, execution authority, runtime strategy mutation, or treating provisional marks or known metric-gap growth as resolved economic edge. Its current economic decision is updated by a newly resolved lifecycle, a new technical-gap identity, unexplained lifecycle disappearance, or materially different after-cost forward evidence.
limitations: The measured window is one 43.22-minute prefix of one running process and is not an independent market sample.
Open-lifecycle marks, excursions, ignored-exit paths, and profit-lock states can reverse before venue close.
The delta attributes arithmetic changes but does not estimate causal strategy edge, counterfactual fills, or future profit.
The 20 additional null pressure values come from the already-loaded old runner and do not test the staged source repair.
Right-censored count reduction reflects path maturation and does not imply favorable outcomes.
No route, process, order, position, stop, target, allocation, drain, or protection changed in this revision.
